## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 28.06.2026 - 11.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Kaka hindustan gamer_, 11.08.2026, 1/5: "I'm a free user, I delete this app due to paywall because can't work for analyse my weekly tracker & monthly widgets & still the main feature of the app habit tracker is not work because you have to pay for this"
            2. _Sushil Jaiswar_, 14.07.2026, 5/5: "it's totally free guys! you can go for it. this is best habit tracker app for beginner who can't afford expensive premium membership and it will also remind you 👌 you can create multiple habits on it without any expenses like other app 🤝"
            3. _Tanvir Sadid_, 07.07.2026, 5/5: "Very Friendly. But premium subscription are so expensive."
<!--/ir-theme-->
